note: Closed registry IDs, recovered from the module-doc history on main at 90ada43. Open IDs are NOT listed here: they are read from the open-task sections of docs/modules/*.md, which stay the source of truth. The change that closes a task removes its module entry and appends its ID here, so closed plus open is the number of tasks ever registered. IDs are never renumbered or reused. CORE-5, CORE-6 and VLLM-15 were each removed by their completing change and then restored verbatim by a later branch merge that kept both sides of the open-task list; they are recorded here so the same resurrection fails CI instead of going unnoticed. retired_never_landed records IDs that were registered on a branch and retired before reaching main: they were never open tasks here, so they are not counted, but their numbers are still never reused.
